root_cause_criterion.criterion: Immediately before the newline search, the memchr span `size` must not exceed the remaining input extent `end - *position`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable helper decrements the caller budget with `size--` and then calls `memchr(*position, '\n', size)` without the missing clamp `if (size > end - *position) size = end - *position;`. On the witnessed vulnerable call the root predicate is false (2047 > 50), while the fixed original makes the predicate true at the same call site.

nodes.state: At `memchr(*position, '\n', size)`, the vulnerable execution uses `size == 2047` while only `end - *position == 50` bytes remain, so the search overruns the 50-byte fuzz input blob.

edges.relation: The `size` value produced by `size--;` is passed unchanged as the third argument of the immediately following `memchr(*position, '\n', size)` call.
